blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 22-year-old habal-habal driver listed among Central Visayas’ most wanted persons was arrested in Talisay City on Wednesday night, September 23, in connection with two counts of statutory rape. The suspect, who goes by the alias “Samyong,” was arrested around 8 p.m. in Camp 6, Barangay Manipis, Talisay City, by the Tracker Team of the Toledo City Police Station. Police identified him as a resident of Barangay Camp 8, Toledo City, and said he is ranked No. 10 on the regional list of most wanted persons, No. 2 at the provincial level, and No. 2 at the […]...
